name: dogfood-openai-tool-agent
description: Dogfood app 2 (v1.12-3) — an OpenAI Chat Completions tool-use agent that exercises function calling, multi-tool orchestration (weather / calculator / search), and parallel tool calls, drivable in both KIWA_MODE=real (calls the real OpenAI chat/completions endpoint when OPENAI_API_KEY is set) and KIWA_MODE=mock (@kiwa-test/ai-llm createOpenAIMock) so behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-test/quality-metrics 11-axis release gate.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-test/ai-llm -F @kiwa-test/core -F @kiwa-test/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
